paragraphs: Fermi Inc's stock price is 6.4 as of the last update, with a change of -3.03% from the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The company's stock has seen recent price action, with the last update being on August 14, 2026.

There have been 2 new news articles in the last 24 hours, both related to Fermi receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, a data center campus it is developing in west Texas. The news articles were reported by Bloomberg on August 14, 2026, with one article providing a summary of the subpoena and the project.

Fermi has filed several recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026. There has been one Form 4 filing, and 10 new social posts in the last 24 hours, with some discussing the company's stock price and prospects.
